title: SETKEY ECC priv: ForceZero raw[] on export error path
description: wc_ecc_export_private_only writes to a stack buffer raw[ECC_MAXSIZE] before returning. If the export fails, we return immediately without calling ForceZero on raw[]. The success path and the FIPS-minimum rejection path both call ForceZero, but the export-failure early return at line 473 does not. Fix: call ForceZero(raw, sizeof(raw)) before the early return.
